evaluations.description: Complete wire-object equality against fixed feasible witnesses and finite contradictions. Novel domain: DELTA forced at 75; OMEGA choices 75/135. At 75 it collides; at 135 rest is 40 and objective=0. Collision objective is nonnegative so independent bounded optimum is 0. Changed slot 180 changes allocation; rest 41 makes original choices impossible. Base witness and sums come from prepared data oracle; no candidate/helper solver supplies answers.
